title: The Power of Discipline
body: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment. In sports, talent might win you games, but it is the daily, unseen discipline in training that wins you championships.

questions.question: What bridges goals and accomplishment?
questions.explanation: Discipline is explicitly stated as the bridge.

title: Failure is Fuel
body: I've missed more than 9,000 shots in my career. I've lost almost 300 games. Twenty-six times, I've been trusted to take the game-winning shot and missed. I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.

questions.question: Why does the speaker say they succeed?
options: Because they failed over and over again
questions.explanation: Success often comes from learning through repeated failures.
